Thanks — I kicked off a quick internal checklist so we’re aligned on what to probe. Summary below (will expand after we see the sample payloads):

Technical litmus checklist (initial):
1) Model mapping: ensure Silverpine model variants map cleanly to Redwood catalog variants (float16 / int8 compatibility).
2) Quantization & perf: run vbench on the primary model to check latency delta for int8/4-bit profiles.
3) Cold-start probe: spin cold instances, run 50 synthetic sessions and measure first-token latency and KV-cache warmup (we’ll log per-token timings).
4) Sustained throughput: ramp to 100 QPS over 10m, hold for 15m, observe autoscaling and tail latencies.
5) KV cache resumption: simulate multi-session handoff and verify no token duplication/degradation.
6) Failover & fallback: trigger a variant fallback and a region fallback (if allowed) and measure error rate + recovery time.
7) Safety & quality smoke: run your prompt set (10–20 prompts) and compare top-1 outputs to baseline (we’ll snapshot outputs).
8) Resource accounting: capture per-token GPU utilization and memory footprint for capacity planning.

What we need from Silverpine asap:
- Sample payloads (JSON) with headers and expected response shape.
- A test account or API key scoped to a sandbox project.
- Allowlist IPs (we will provide Redwood egress IPs if you need them).

Security note: if Private deployment tests are scheduled we’ll require the standard onboarding checklist (SOC2 evidence, KMS/HSM details). If you prefer, we can do Dedicated validation first to avoid exchanging keys for a VPC test.

Attachment: silverpine-access-ips.txt (text/plain) — includes Redwood test egress IPs and port recommendations.

Team — thanks for the artifacts. Here’s a concise plan & acceptance checklist so we’re all aligned before the Wed triage: 

1) Schedule
- Smoke runs: Oct 20 (Dedicated), Oct 21 (Private sandbox) — each 2hr window.
- Triage call: Wed 10/13 09:00 PDT (confirming attendees).

2) Canary ramp suggestion (post-validation)
- 0–5% traffic for 24h, monitor error rate & quality deltas
- 5–25% over 48h if no regressions, then 25–100% in stages and automated rollback on regressions

3) Acceptance criteria (pass/fail):
- Perf: p50 streaming token latency < 90ms, p95 single-turn < 400ms at target batch sizes.
- Stability: no more than 1% error rate during a 15m sustained 100 QPS hold.
- KV correctness: pass all 10 prompt handoff checks (no duplication/lost tokens).
- Quality: top-1 outputs match Silverpine baseline for >= 80% of prompts (manual review for failures).

4) Deliverables from Redwood after each run:
- perf.csv (per-token latencies), raw-output snapshots (JSON), failure trace samples, and a short runbook of observed mitigations.

5) Risk & open items:
- If Private/VPC tests are needed we will need SOC2 attestation and an IP allowlist signed off by both sides.
- Confirm whether test data contains any PII; if so Silverpine to provide anonymized set.

If this looks good, we’ll confirm the smoke windows and I’ll put calendar invites on everyone’s calendars.

Thanks — Karthik
